fullPassage: Sociologists argue that our perception and usage of time are not just basic properties of nature, like a clock ticking away in the background, nor are they simply psychological phenomena of individual experience. Instead, how we perceive and understand time is to a large degree shaped by tradition and cultural norms. Eviatar Zerubavel's work, The Seven Day Circle: The History and Meaning of the Week, demonstrates how the week, a fundamental unit of time, is a social invention that varies across cultures, influencing how people structure their activities and rhythms of life. Why do we consider a nine-to-five job routine? Why don't many of us work on the weekends? Why do we usually pay our bills at the end of the month? Why is the retirement age sixty-five? These numbers and patterns aren't really dictated by nature or any essential human characteristic, but are rather social creations that we internalize and come to accept as "normal."

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 work의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 일하다 — (B) 저작(작품): (A)는 Zerubavel의 '저작(책)'이므로 일하다가 아님
✅ ② (A) 저작(작품) — (B) 일하다: (A)는 The Seven Day Circle이라는 '저작(work)', (B)는 밤늦게까지 '일하다(work)'로 각 문맥에 맞음 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 저작(작품) — (B) 저작(작품): (B)는 '밤늦게까지 일하다'이므로 저작이 아님
❌ ④ (A) 일하다 — (B) 일하다: (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀜
det.tip: work: ① (저술된) 저작/작품 ② 일하다 — Zerubavel's work는 ① 저작

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the period of your life after you permanently stop working, usually because of your age"

det.korean: retirement=은퇴 (나이 때문에 영구히 일을 그만둔 이후의 시기)
det.analysis:
❌ ① tradition: tradition(전통)은 오랜 관습으로 정의와 무관
❌ ② invention: invention(발명)은 새로 만들어낸 것으로 정의와 다름
✅ ③ retirement: retirement(은퇴)는 '나이 때문에 영구히 일을 그만둔 이후의 시기'라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ routine: routine(일상)은 반복되는 일과로 정의와 다름
det.tip: Why is the retirement age sixty-five? — 은퇴(retirement)

questions.passage: Sociologists argue that our perception and usage of time are not just basic properties of nature. Instead, how we perceive and understand time is to a large degree __________ (shape) by tradition and cultural norms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: how we perceive and understand time is ... __________ (shape) by tradition — 주어 뒤에 be동사 is가 있고 'by ~'가 이어지는 수동태 자리입니다. be동사 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 shape를 shaped로 바꿔 '형성된다'는 뜻을 만듭니다
det.tip: is shaped by tradition and cultural norms — 수동태 be + 과거분사(shaped)

questions.passage: Eviatar Zerubavel's work demonstrates how the week, a fundamental unit of time, is a social invention that varies across cultures, __________ (influence) how people structure their activities and rhythms of life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 앞 절에 이어지는 분사구문 자리이므로 influence → influencing(현재분사)
det.analysis: ... a social invention that varies across cultures, __________ (influence) how people structure their activities — 앞 문장 전체를 받아 '~하면서'의 의미를 더하는 분사구문 자리입니다. 능동 의미이므로 influence를 현재분사 influencing으로 바꿔 '영향을 미치면서'라는 뜻을 만듭니다
det.tip: varies across cultures, influencing how people structure — 분사구문 현재분사(influencing)

questions.passage: Sociologists argue that our perception and usage of time are not just basic properties of nature, like a clock ticking away in the background, nor are they simply psychological phenomena of individual experience. Instead, how we perceive and understand time is to a large degree shaped by tradition and cultural norms. Eviatar Zerubavel's work, The Seven Day Circle: The History and Meaning of the Week, demonstrates how the week, a fundamental unit of time, is a social invention that varies __________, influencing how people structure their activities and rhythms of life. Why do we consider a nine-to-five job routine? Why don't many of us work on the weekends? Why do we usually pay our bills at the end of the month? Why is the retirement age sixty-five? These numbers and patterns aren't really dictated by nature or any essential human characteristic, but are rather social creations that we internalize and come to accept as "normal."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주(週)는 '문화마다(across cultures)' 다른 사회적 산물이라는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① across cultures: 원문 일치. 주(週)가 '문화마다(across cultures)' 달라지는 사회적 산물이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② over the years: '세월에 걸쳐'는 시간 변화로, 문화 간 차이라는 초점과 어긋남
❌ ③ by its nature: '본질적으로'는 주(週)가 자연이 아니라 사회적 산물이라는 논지와 반대
❌ ④ in our minds: '우리 마음속에서'는 문화 간 차이를 설명하지 못함
det.tip: a social invention that varies across cultures — 문화마다

questions.passage: Sociologists argue that our perception and usage of time are not just basic properties of nature, like a clock ticking away in the background, nor are they simply psychological phenomena of individual experience. Instead, how we perceive and understand time is to a large degree shaped by tradition and cultural norms. Eviatar Zerubavel's work, The Seven Day Circle: The History and Meaning of the Week, demonstrates how the week, a fundamental unit of time, is a social invention that varies across cultures, influencing how people structure their activities and rhythms of life. Why do we consider a nine-to-five job routine? Why don't many of us work on the weekends? Why do we usually pay our bills at the end of the month? Why is the retirement age sixty-five? These numbers and patterns aren't really dictated by nature or any essential human characteristic, but are rather __________ that we internalize and come to accept as "normal."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 숫자·패턴은 자연이 아니라 '사회적 창조물(social creations)'이라는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① natural facts: '자연적 사실'은 자연이 정한 것이 아니라는 원문과 반대
❌ ② physical limits: '물리적 한계'는 숫자·패턴의 사회적 성격과 무관
❌ ③ biological needs: '생물학적 욕구'는 본질적 인간 특성에서 나온 것이 아니라는 맥락과 어긋남
✅ ④ social creations: 원문 일치. 이 숫자·패턴이 자연이 아니라 우리가 내면화한 '사회적 창조물(social creations)'이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: are rather social creations that we internalize — 사회적 창조물
